correctness.rationale: The classical Picard classes of all 27 lines yield five paired residual components and column image 5(-K-[line]); each has even total coefficient. The exact meeting graph identity \(A^2=5I-4A+5J\) and trace zero imply \(\det A=2\cdot5^7\). The line classes generate Picard rank 7, and 5e_line supplies an independent odd-parity generator in the kernel of Pic mod5. Thus the two image indices agree and all asserted invariant factors and the sharp order ten follow. The shipped exact verifier checks each finite geometric identity and determinant, with an independent SymPy Smith form check. Universal geometry comes from the blow-up theorem, not sampled examples.

value.rationale: The 27 geometrically canonical conic pencils define a complete intrinsic family of ten-line supports. Determining their integral span is a motivated reconstruction problem with concrete parity and Picard-mod-five obstructions, exact finite quotient, and sharp tenfold multiplier for any individual line. The theorem is an integral structural refinement of the known rational spectrum, neither an arbitrary selected minor nor a Picard torsion claim. A separate downstream application is not required for this natural complete classification.
